source_of_truth.pixels: motion/webexport/export_booking.py (verbatim: bf_pair shadow, flowers + flower-shadow layers, place2x, clip_rows2x, shadow k=1.08-0.08g) evaluated at t = 470 + i/2 using fix10b_bf_curve BFC.body(t) * BSC*K10B
source_of_truth.renders: integer frames = approved /tmp/v37m/f10b/bf (+hov/fr); half frames = booking/tools/render_bf60.py (= arrival_butterfly_v37_fix10b.py, ROOTZ -40, body 100% 32spp, bshadow 16spp, motion blur wings only, shutter 0.5 @30fps, subframe .5); new hover angles = bf_angles_v37_fix10b.py (no mblur)

display.position: absolute inside the existing place box; object-fit: fill; decode shader = hero/gate/bench (top premult RGB, bottom alpha, a=clamp((A-.006)/.988)*uvEdge(smoothstep(0,.015)), rgb=min(rgb,a))

1440.css_ratio_check: 291/217 = 1.3410; video 592/464 = 1.2759 vs box 1.2933 (object-fit: fill undoes the mod-16 resample)

390.css_ratio_check: 195/113 = 1.7257; video 400/224 = 1.7857 vs box 1.7257 (object-fit: fill undoes the mod-16 resample)

clip_line.rule: 390 only: butterfly+shadow rows below CLIPY = button top + 3 px are cleared (export_booking clip_rows2x, baked in video); shadow line = button top

deviations: 1440 video is 592x464 (not 592x448): the video box extends 8 CSS px ABOVE the place box (top:-8px, height:225px). Wing tip at f488 touched the box top and the 1.5% uv-edge feather cut it by up to 9.5% alpha; with TOPPAD max loss 1.0%. 390 unchanged 400x224.
hover angle range is 85 -> 73 deg (BookingScene hoverTheta = 85 - 6*smoothstep(tau/0.3)*(1-cos(2*pi*tau/1.6))), not 30+-6.

landing.play: once; on `ended` swap to breathe (src frame 76 = f508 == breathe frame 0 = f509 pose, source delta 0.012/255 mean)

breathe.t: ping-pong f509..f542..f509 (i<=66: 509+i/2, else 509+(132-i)/2) == breatheIndexAt linear ping-pong over 34 atlas frames, period 2.2s

hover.integration: desktop only (hover:hover). 38d4 entry ramp (smoothstep 0.3s) and leave (hold then 600ms ease back) -> CSS opacity crossfade 300ms breathe<->hover; hover frame 0 vs breathe frame 0 source delta 0.012/255, so starting hover at currentTime 0 is seamless only when breathe is near frame 0/131; otherwise crossfade.

poster.frame: decoded landing frame 10 = f475 = BOOKING_MOTION_HOLD_FRAME 5 @30fps (same frame as live booking-poster-motion-<bp>.webp)
poster.integration: if poster is shown before play, start landing at currentTime = 10/60 s; if not, play from 0 (transparent fade-in)

end_poster.frame: decoded landing frame 76 = f508 (= breathe frame 0); reduced-motion / idle-freeze still

timing_notes: trigger/visibility rules unchanged from BookingScene (IntersectionObserver start, idle freeze after landing -> show end-poster or pause breathe at frame 0).
encoding: High@L4.2, ref=4 explicit, bt709 primaries/transfer/matrix tv-range in SPS VUI and container, +faststart. CRF: landing 14, breathe/hover 16. Seam frames pinned with x264 zones q=12 (q=14 taper before) so loop/swap boundaries carry the same low noise.

booking-d-landing-stack.mp4.x264: ref=4 bframes=2 keyint=600 preset=veryslow +faststart; crf=14.0 zones=68,71,q=14/72,76,q=12

booking-m-landing-stack.mp4.x264: ref=4 bframes=2 keyint=600 preset=veryslow +faststart; crf=14.0 zones=68,71,q=14/72,76,q=12
